Type: globe stick floor lamp
Use: ambient light in a corner or beside a sofa; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, glam, art deco
Materials: white opal glass globe, brass pole, black marble base
Colors: white, warm gold brass, black marble
Shape: very thin tall stick, single round glass globe on top, short black cylinder marble base, minimal and airy
Feel: elegant, refined, airy
Goes with: velvet, brass accents, white or dark walls, walnut; mid-century, glam or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Globe Stick Floor Lamp, 69"H, Black Marble
product.description: This floor lamp is sleek and subtle in design, the tall, slim metal upright rising from a solid, sturdy cylindrical base to end in a globe shade that will shed diffused light. As much sculpture as lamp, this piece will add a pop of interest to any room. This floor lamp is made out of metal, marble and acrylic. This floor lamp will help light your living space, providing a warm ambiance. The stylish combination of metal and acrylic gives this lamp structural appeal. 9"W x 9"D x 69"H Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes This lamp comes with a bulb and is rated for indoor use.
